regions.region: page 7 upper and middle text, continuation of Note 20 racemic preparation
regions.finding: The original page image completes the existing racemic-control experiment: CuBr/4 Å sieves/toluene coupling at 25 °C for 12 h, ZnI2/NaI rearrangement at 110 °C for 6 h, and TBAF·3H2O desilylation from 0 °C to room temperature for 2 h, followed by workup/chromatography to (±)-3 (113.0 mg, 74%). This evidence enriches the existing page-6 record rather than creating a duplicate.

regions.region: page 7 lower Note 21 chiral HPLC and characterization
regions.finding: Chiral-HPLC conditions and retention times, optical rotation, and characterization belong to the existing first full-scale (R)-3 preparation. The ee measurement basis and retention times were added to that record; characterization is not a second preparation.

regions.region: page 8 upper Handling and Disposal of Hazardous Chemicals
regions.finding: Safety guidance and liability text only; no reaction arrow, table row, experimental condition, product, or outcome is defined in this region.

regions.region: page 8 lower Discussion historical methods and introduction to Schemes 2–3
regions.finding: The text classifies the Crabbé CuBr method and the authors' CuI modification as prior work, notes the paraformaldehyde limitation, and introduces the earlier ZnI2- and CuI-based 1,3-disubstituted-allene protocols shown on page 9. The generic statement that no allene forms with other aldehydes does not identify individual substrates/conditions and is not fabricated as a zero-yield row.

unresolved: The Crabbé and modified terminal-allene summaries do not restate experiment-level substrate identities, quantities, times, or yields on this page.
The phrase 'other aldehydes' is generic; individual failed aldehydes and analytical detection limits are not reported.

regions.region: page 10 upper and center narrative on axially chiral alpha-allenols
